title: LunqDebloater profile
description: What LunqDebloater removes from a Windows 11 image and which registry changes it makes. The profile is made of categories that can be turned on and off before the build.

$schema.description: Link to this schema, so that the editor offers completion and checks the file.

Name.description: Profile name shown when the Config folder holds several profiles. Default: the file name.

Description.description: What the profile does, shown under its name.

Requirements.description: Which Windows build the profile is made for. The script checks it right after reading the ISO. Without this block no check is made. -SkipVersionCheck ignores it.

Build.description: Build number that must match exactly: 26300 is 26H2, 26200 is 25H2, 26100 is 24H2.

MinRevision.description: Lowest revision, the number after the dot in 26300.9457. Anything newer is fine.

RemoveFeaturePayload.description: Also delete the files of turned off Windows features (DISM /Remove). They can then be turned on again only from a source with the files.

Categories.description: Categories: each one holds everything about one topic (apps, components, features, registry) and can be turned on or off as a whole.

Appx.description: Legacy format (without Categories): apps to remove.

Capabilities.description: Legacy format (without Categories): capabilities to remove.

Features.description: Legacy format (without Categories): optional features to turn off.

Packages.description: Legacy format (without Categories): CBS packages to remove.

localizedText.description: Text as a plain string, or translations by language code. The interface language is used, then English, then the first one given.

nameList.description: Names exactly as DISM shows them. Wildcards * and ? are allowed.

Id.description: Short unique name, used by -SkipCategory and in the build report.

Name.description: Category name shown before the build. Default: the Id.

Description.description: What the category does, shown in the category list.

Enabled.description: false: the category is skipped unless you turn it on before the build.

Appx.description: Provisioned Appx apps to remove, by DisplayName (Get-AppxProvisionedPackage). Wildcards allowed.

Features.description: Optional features to turn off (Get-WindowsOptionalFeature). Wildcards allowed.

Packages.description: CBS packages to remove. Careful: removing them can break Windows updates. Wildcards allowed.

Hive.description: SOFTWARE (HKLM\SOFTWARE), SYSTEM (HKLM\SYSTEM, use ControlSet001 instead of CurrentControlSet) or DefaultUser (HKCU of every new user).

Path.description: Key path inside the hive, without the hive itself, for example Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection.

Name.description: Value name. Leave it out (or empty) for the default value of the key.

Action.description: Set writes the value (default), DeleteValue deletes the value, DeleteKey deletes the key with all its subkeys.

Value.description: Value data. REG_DWORD and REG_QWORD: a number or a string "0x..." (for a QWORD above 9223372036854775807 use the "0x..." form). REG_SZ and REG_EXPAND_SZ: a string, written as is. REG_MULTI_SZ: an array of strings. REG_BINARY: a hex string such as "de ad be ef".
